newsitem.title: USA: U.S. officials say no budget agreement yet.
newsitem.headline: U.S. officials say no budget agreement yet.

text.p: Administration officials said on Thursday that there was not yet any budget agreement between the White House and Congress.
"There's no agreement," said one administration official who asked not to be identified. "There's still important issues that have not been resolved yet," he added, declining to elaborate.

Another administration official said that the unresolved issues included Medicare, taxes and non-defense discretionary spending. The official suggested an accord could be reached later in the day, but said Friday was also possible.
